memory_limits: The 2 MiB limit bounds one retained payload per profile, not whole-process RSS or startup peak. Arc and allocator overhead remain; clones do not duplicate payload. Root reports actual X230 SSH length 846888 B; this reviewer has not independently measured that host file.
